text_block_list.text:
I spot Уиннинг Тикит running toward
me, tears in
her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I... sob... I did something horrible to Mr. Chalk!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I got called on during class and had to write the answer on the blackboard...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So I thought, "All right! Let's show them
how it's
done!" And I grabbed Mr. Chalk
real tight. But
then...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
There was a loud crack! I snapped poor
Mr. Chalk
in twoooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Urghh... It's all my fault! Mr. Chalk
could've
written so much more in life!
But I snapped that
life short!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! It's so sad—I can't go on!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps Уиннинг Тикит needs to learn
how to
apply a little less force
sometimes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
